import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json
p=Path.cwd()
for n in ['weighted','entanglement','digraph']:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources'/ (n+'.pdf')),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/'+n+'.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
 print('PRIMARY',n,'CHARS',len(r.stdout));print(r.stdout if n=='weighted' else r.stdout[:16000])
print('HISTORY COMPACT')
m=json.loads((p/'history-matches.json').read_text());print([(Path(x['file']).parent.name,x['location']) for x in m])
